# KnightRate

> KnightRate is a course-review platform for University of Central Florida students. Students search UCF courses, read and post ratings/reviews (difficulty, workload, grading fairness, professor), bookmark classes, and find course resources — all backed by real student accounts and moderated review data.

## Key pages

- [Home](/): search classes and see trending courses
- [Course search](/): filter and sort the full UCF course catalog
- [About](/): what KnightRate is and who built it
- [FAQ](/): common questions about using the site

## Notes

- Course and review data is live and user-generated; it is not available as a static export.
- Account creation requires a valid email for verification.
